map.moi_truong_tu_nhien_mang_dac_trung_nhiet: The natural environment is tropical, with hills and mountains covering about three quarters of the land along the main terrain ranges. Fertile alluvial plains and dense river networks lie between the mountains. A long coastline opens onto expansive seas, offering abundant natural resources, minerals, fisheries and diverse ecosystems. The tropical monsoon climate features high humidity, averaging over 80%, and annual rainfall of 1,500–2,000 mm. Weather varies with altitude and monsoon winds, creating different seasonal patterns: some regions have cold winters and hot, rainy summers, while others stay warm throughout the year with distinct wet and dry seasons. The combination of mountains and sea supports a vibrant ecosystem and many natural benefits, alongside challenges from storms, floods and droughts.
